sentences: Traders moved $645 million through Polymarket in the week of 2026-06-15, across 20.6 million individual trades. Algorithmic wallets accounted for 61% of weekly counterparty events (both maker and taker sides counted); everyone else split the remaining 39%.
The most-traded market was "Will Oh Se-hoon win the 2026 Seoul Mayoral Election?", pulling in $3 million of volume.
Both sides made money this week. Bots collected $6 million (+98 bps); retail collected $88K (+10 bps).
